class.name: VoxelWorld
class.brief_description: Node for generating infinite voxel terrain.
class.description: VoxelWorld generates an infinite procedural voxel terrain similar to Minecraft. The terrain is generated at runtime using Perlin noise and consists of colored blocks (no textures). The world is divided into chunks (16x64x16 blocks each) that are loaded and unloaded dynamically based on the active camera's position and the configured [member chunk_load_radius]. [b]Note:[/b] Terrain generation only occurs at runtime. In the editor, VoxelWorld appears as an empty node with configurable properties. Set [member seed] to -1 for random terrain each run, or to a specific value for reproducible worlds.

members.member: The seed used for terrain generation. Set to [code]-1[/code] for a random seed each time the game runs, or to a specific positive integer for reproducible terrain.
The radius (in chunks) around the camera within which terrain chunks are loaded. Higher values show more terrain but use more memory and processing time. Valid range: 2 to 16.
The world-space size of each voxel block. Default is 1.0 (1 meter per block).
The Y-level at which water generates. Blocks below this level that are not solid terrain will be filled with water. Valid range: 0 to 63.
